title: Scale paddle ownership dual labels — wavea-* priority, visual annotation
whatWasBuilt: 30 new multi-paddle ownership frames, visually annotated from absolute-CFR extracted frames, appended as NEW per-bundle annotation files (bundles/<case>/annotation/devin-visual-v2-waveC.json) plus 30 appended ownership-review.json sidecar entries carrying per-box pixel boxes, wrist-proximity and uncertainty notes. No existing file or label was modified except the append to ownership-review.json; held-out cases (wm-dink-01, afn-vic-rally1) received no new labels. Added datasets/paddle-bench/ownership-review/README.md with recomputed registry counts.

provenance.frameExtraction: ffmpeg -vf select=eq(n\,IDX) absolute CFR frame indexing (no seek-based -ss indexing) — extractor and per-frame manifest kept outside the repo (session workspace), all tMs recorded from frame index / fps

sources.wavea-944403-dink / wavea-944403-smash: dvids-944403.mp4 (60000/1001 fps) — downloaded from committed corpus source URL, SHA-256 verified byte-identical to datasets/corpus/sources.json
sources.wavea-faead-rally: DOD_110692879.mp4 (24 fps), SHA-256 verified vs corpus metadata
sources.afn-sasebo-rally1: committed bundle clip clock convention (30000/1001 fps), tMs matches existing label convention

provenance.visualMethod: every labeled point read off a viewed frame via coordinate-grid zoom crops; ambiguous boxes recorded sidecar-only with uncertainty notes; occluded target frames recorded as visibility=occluded with no point; nothing interpolated

sameTimestampTargetOtherDualFrames.definition: frames with >=1 visible target point AND >=1 visible other point at the same tMs, aggregated across annotator files per bundle; recomputed from committed files

hardSliceCoverage: included and flagged in notes: edge-on blades (dink far-center, smash near-left sliver, faead-feed target), dark-on-dark low contrast (smash smasher vs trees, faead-rally target vs fence), motion blur (sasebo partner paddle +-15px), net-post/net-tape partial occlusion (sasebo 0021, marne ARMY red blade)
honestNegatives: Program headline is duals 30 -> 60+; this lands at 50 strict same-timestamp target+other duals (+20). The other 10 annotated frames have the target paddle occluded/uncertain plus >=2 other/ambiguous paddles — occlusion recorded honestly instead of inventing target points.
wavea bundle-local clip.mp4 files are NOT committed (contrary to the workstream brief); frames were extracted from hash-verified corpus source videos instead, using each bundle's recording clock.
4 target-occluded frames and 6 ambiguous boxes were deliberately left without coordinates; several visible boxes carry +-8..15px boundary uncertainty notes (blur/edge-on/dark-on-dark) in the sidecar.

STATUS_BOARD's '78 target / 83 other' uses a counting this work could not reproduce from committed files (annotation-file visible points recompute to 65/81; sidecar per-box verdicts to 38/79); README lists all denominators separately rather than reconciling by guesswork.
No cascade / S3 P-R numbers are reported: pnpm lab:regen and the pose cascade are macOS-only and runs/ dirs are absent — measuring ownership P/R on the enlarged set remains blocked on a macOS run.
remainsBlocked: Re-measuring S3 ownership P/R against the enlarged (50-dual) instrument: requires pnpm lab:regen on macOS (Apple Vision pose) with local media; cannot be run in this Linux session and numbers were not fabricated.

Remaining wavea bundles (wavea-marne-serve, wavea-sasebo-volleys, wavea-wgm-wheelchair) not yet dual-labeled: not reached within this pass; further scaling needs more review passes on their source windows.
